purpose: Describe how REDWOOD project measurements are derived without changing universal PHY data.

rules.notes: Vitruvian working target for neutral T-pose layout.
Initial 5 mm end allowance per side for trimming, squaring, and hand carving.
Small bones need smaller trimming allowance to avoid excessive waste.
Long grain follows load path through limb bones.
MVP rule to keep drilled pin holes from splitting redwood near joint ends.
Brass bushings prevent copper/brass pins from wallowing redwood holes during repeated motion.
